description: This file defines a service class `FixerService` that provides functionality to automatically fix assets with detected issues by replacing logos, copying assets when necessary, updating issues and statuses within a job processing pipeline.

classes.name: FixerService
classes.description: Service class for applying automatic fixes to assets by replacing logos and updating issue and job statuses.

methods.name: None __init__(self, state_store: StateStore)
methods.description: Initializes FixerService with a given StateStore.

methods.name: List[Detection] _load_detections_for_asset(self, job_id: str, asset_rel_path: str)
methods.description: Loads detection data for a specific asset in a job from a JSON file.

methods.name: Path|None _choose_new_logo(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Selects the new logo file from the analysis directory for a given job.

methods.name: Path fix_asset(self, job_id: str, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fixes a single asset by replacing the old logo with a new one based on detections, updating issues and statuses.

methods.name: List[Path] fix_all(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Automatically fixes all assets with open issues in a job, applying logo replacements and updating statuses.
